def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for keyfun in (lambda p: p[0] - p[1], lambda p: p[0] + p[1]):
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for c in cells:
            groups[keyfun(c)].append(c)
        for cs in groups.values():
            if len(cs) < 2:
                continue
            cs.sort()
            a, b = cs[0], cs[-1]
            fc = grid[a[0]][a[1]]
            if grid[b[0]][b[1]] != fc:
                continue
            step = (1, 1) if keyfun(a) == a[0] - a[1] else (1, -1)
            i, j = a
            while (i, j) != b:
                if out[i][j] == bg:
                    out[i][j] = fc
                i, j = i + step[0], j + step[1]
            perp = (lambda p: p[0] + p[1]) if keyfun(a) == a[0] - a[1] else (lambda p: p[0] - p[1])
            for (i, j) in cs:
                if (i, j) in (a, b):
                    continue
                if grid[i][j] != fc:
                    v = grid[i][j]
                    d = (-1, 1) if perp((i, j)) == i + j else (1, 1)
                    x, y = i, j
                    while 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:
                        out[x][y] = v
                        x, y = x + d[0], y + d[1]
                    x, y = i - d[0], j - d[1]
                    while 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w:
                        out[x][y] = v
                        x, y = x - d[0], y - d[1]
    return out
'''
